title: Rav Huna bar Toreta
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Chullin 127a, saying: “Once I went to Va’ad and saw a snake wrapped around a lizard… When I came before Rabbi Shimon the Pious,” etc. Yuchasin cites from a Midrash that he was a convert, and that because his cow would not plow on Shabbat he became a Jew; the story is cited in Pesikta Rabbati, piska Parah, and the reading Hyman uses is Rabbi Yochanan ben Toreta.

notes.text: The consulted Pesikta Rabbati 14 story names Yochanan ben Tortah. A Jewish seller explains the cow’s refusal to plow on Shabbat to its gentile buyer, who converts. This parallel does not independently establish an identity with Rav Huna bar Toreta in Chullin; the Yuchasin account remains attributed.
